rows.name: Performance
rows.originalFormula: (Ideal Cycle Time × Total Count) / Run Time

rows.name: Asset Utilization
rows.originalFormula: Actual Operating Time / Available Asset Time

rows.name: TEEP
rows.originalFormula: OEE × Loading where Loading = Planned Production Time / Calendar Time

rows.name: Run Rate Attainment
rows.originalFormula: Actual Run Rate / Target Run Rate × 100

rows.name: Constraint Utilization
rows.originalFormula: Constraint Run Time / Constraint Available Time × 100

rows.name: Schedule Adherence
rows.originalFormula: Production completed as scheduled / Scheduled production × 100

rows.name: Orders Completed to Schedule
rows.originalFormula: Orders completed on scheduled date / Total scheduled orders × 100

rows.name: Ideal Cycle Time
rows.originalFormula: Best demonstrated or engineered cycle time per unit

rows.name: Cycle Time Variance
rows.originalFormula: Actual Cycle Time − Standard Cycle Time

rows.name: Cycle Time Performance
rows.originalFormula: Standard Cycle Time / Actual Cycle Time × 100

rows.name: Manufacturing Lead Time
rows.originalFormula: Queue + Setup + Run + Move + Wait Time

rows.name: Touch Time
rows.originalFormula: Actual processing time spent on product

rows.name: Average Downtime Event
rows.originalFormula: Total Downtime / Number of Downtime Events

rows.name: Speed Loss
rows.originalFormula: Potential Output at Ideal Rate − Actual Output during runtime

rows.name: Changeover Time
rows.originalFormula: First Good Unit New Product − Last Good Unit Previous Product

rows.name: Average Changeover Time
rows.originalFormula: Σ Changeover Time / Number of Changeovers

rows.name: Setup Loss
rows.originalFormula: Actual Setup Time − Target Setup Time

rows.name: FPY — First Pass Yield
rows.originalFormula: Units passing without rework / Units entering process × 100

rows.name: First Time Through
rows.originalFormula: Good units requiring no repair/rework / Total units × 100

rows.name: Good Count
rows.originalFormula: Total Count − Scrap − rejected/rework as governed

rows.name: Rolled Throughput Yield
rows.originalFormula: RTY = FPY₁ × FPY₂ × FPY₃ × ... × FPYₙ ; RTY = 0.98 × 0.97 × 0.99 = 94.1%

rows.name: MTBF
rows.originalFormula: Total Operating Time / Number of Failures

rows.name: MTTR — Mean Time to Repair
rows.originalFormula: Total Active Repair Time / Number of Repairs

rows.name: MTTR — Mean Time to Restore
rows.originalFormula: Total Restoration Downtime / Number of Incidents

rows.name: MTTF
rows.originalFormula: Total Operating Life / Number of Nonrepairable Failures

rows.name: Reliability
rows.originalFormula: commonly e^(−λt) for constant failure rate

rows.name: Reactive Maintenance %
rows.originalFormula: Reactive Maintenance Hours / Total Maintenance Hours × 100

rows.name: Planned Maintenance %
rows.originalFormula: Planned Maintenance Hours / Total Maintenance Hours × 100

rows.name: PM Compliance
rows.originalFormula: PMs completed on time / PMs scheduled × 100

rows.name: Schedule Compliance — Maintenance
rows.originalFormula: Scheduled jobs completed as planned / Scheduled jobs × 100

rows.name: Maintenance Backlog
rows.originalFormula: Outstanding Maintenance Labor Hours / Available Weekly Maintenance Labor Hours

rows.name: Emergency Work %
rows.originalFormula: Emergency work hours / Total maintenance hours × 100

rows.name: OTIF
rows.originalFormula: Orders delivered On Time AND In Full / Total Orders × 100

rows.name: On-Time Delivery (OTD)
rows.originalFormula: Orders delivered on/before promise date / Total Delivered Orders × 100

rows.name: Past-Due Quantity
rows.originalFormula: Σ outstanding quantity past promised date

rows.name: Inventory Days / DIO
rows.originalFormula: Average Inventory / COGS × Days in Period

rows.name: Raw Material Days
rows.originalFormula: Average Raw Material Inventory / Material Usage × Days

rows.name: WIP Days
rows.originalFormula: Average WIP / Manufacturing Cost or Throughput × Days

rows.name: WIP Units
rows.originalFormula: Σ units currently inside production process

rows.name: Obsolete Inventory %
rows.originalFormula: Obsolete Inventory Value / Total Inventory Value × 100

rows.name: Excess Inventory %
rows.originalFormula: Inventory Above Governed Maximum / Total Inventory × 100

rows.name: Little's Law
rows.originalFormula: WIP = Throughput × Lead Time ; Lead Time = WIP / Throughput ; Throughput = WIP / Lead Time

rows.name: Labor Efficiency
rows.originalFormula: Standard Hours Earned / Actual Labor Hours × 100

rows.name: Standard Hours Earned
rows.originalFormula: Good Quantity × Standard Labor Time per Unit

rows.name: Labor Utilization
rows.originalFormula: Productive Labor Hours / Paid Labor Hours × 100

rows.name: Direct Labor Utilization
rows.originalFormula: Direct Productive Hours / Direct Available Hours × 100

rows.name: Absenteeism Rate
rows.originalFormula: Absent Scheduled Hours / Total Scheduled Hours × 100

rows.name: Manufacturing Cost per Unit
rows.originalFormula: Total Manufacturing Cost / Good Units Produced

rows.name: Labor Efficiency Variance
rows.originalFormula: (Actual Hours − Standard Hours) × Standard Labor Rate

rows.name: COPQ — Cost of Poor Quality
rows.originalFormula: Internal Failure Cost + External Failure Cost

rows.name: Cost of Quality
rows.originalFormula: Prevention + Appraisal + Internal Failure + External Failure

rows.name: Idle Energy %
rows.originalFormula: Energy During Nonproductive Time / Total Energy × 100

rows.name: Constraint Utilization
rows.originalFormula: Constraint Productive Time / Constraint Available Time × 100

rows.name: Constraint Lost Time
rows.originalFormula: Available Constraint Time − Productive Constraint Time

rows.name: Throughput Contribution
rows.originalFormula: Sales − Totally Variable Cost where governed financial model supports it

rows.name: Schedule Adherence
rows.originalFormula: Production completed according to schedule / Scheduled production × 100

rows.name: Inventory Days
rows.originalFormula: Average Inventory / Consumption or COGS × Days

rows.name: OTIF
rows.originalFormula: Orders on-time AND in-full / Total applicable orders × 100

rows.name: Availability Loss Time
rows.originalFormula: Availability Loss Time = Planned Production Time − Run Time

rows.name: Performance Loss Time
rows.originalFormula: Performance Loss Time = Run Time − (Ideal Cycle Time × Total Count)

rows.name: Quality Loss Units and Quality Loss Time
rows.originalFormula: Quality Loss Units = Total Count − Good Count ; Quality Loss Time = Defective Count × Ideal Cycle Time

rows.name: Lost Units
rows.originalFormula: Lost Units = Expected Units − Actual Good Units

rows.name: Unfavorable Gap to Target
rows.originalFormula: Gap = Target − Actual ; Gap = Actual − Target

rows.name: Trend slope
rows.originalFormula: Regression slope across ordered period/value observations.

rows.name: Sustained Improvement
rows.originalFormula: KPI meets improvement threshold for N consecutive periods

rows.name: On-Time Action Closure
rows.originalFormula: Actions Closed by Due Date / Actions Due × 100
